newsitem.title: INDIA: India's PAL-Peugeot to launch new vehicle in 1997.
newsitem.headline: India's PAL-Peugeot to launch new vehicle in 1997.

text.p: Indian automobile firm PAL-Peugeot will launch a new multipurpose vehicle by December 1997, a company official said on Wednesday.
But J. Manlay, deputy managing director PAL-Peugeot, said the new vehicle would shortly be launched in Europe. He declined to disclose the vehicle's brand name.
PAL-Peugeot manufactures Peugeot 309 cars in India. The company is a joint venture between Indian car maker Premier Automobiles Ltd and French car maker Peugeot.
